description: THE MARKET (rokha.ai/market, GET /api/market) — everything you can run on Rokha in one store: Rokha-native rigs, skills, MCP servers, Forge agents, builders and marketers, plus the WHOLE synced open registry (Smithery, Glama, ClawHub, skills.sh, the MCP Registry, Docker, Anthropic skills…), one order: proven first, then most used — every item runs on Rokha for real (sandbox or remote MCP, a trace on every run). Browse by `aisle` (what it is: all · rig · skill · mcp · agent · builder · marketer) and `dept` (what it is for: all · trading · social · media · research · dev · data · fun); `source` = all · rokha · registry; `sort` = popular (default: ready-to-hire capabilities first, then proven first, then installs/stars/uses across every source) · top (most used on Rokha — uses, then users, then last active; registry: proven, then installs, then stars) · live · new · hired (most hired: paid hires, then USDC paid) · qualified (just qualified: the newest passed qualification first); `price` = any · free · paid (paid = has an active creator product — Buy/Hire); `proven` = 1 for only what ran end to end; `q` (≤ 80 chars) ranks title match > tag > description, proven first within ties; `limit` 1–48 (default 24); pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor` for the next page (opaque, signed, bound to the query). Each item: id, kind, source, title, subtitle, handle, href, image (product art or null), tagline, link, department, tags, official (House), architect (the founder's build), proven, live, new, stats {uses_total, users_total, installs, stars, reach}, price {usd, model, product_id} or null, cta + cta_secondary. Also `total` (null when q is set) and `facets` (aisle + department counts). Pass `ids` (a list of item ids) for exactly those items in that order — the Market view of a set of picks is https://rokha.ai/market?ids=<comma-joined ids>. Never an owner wallet, email or runner identity. Public, no auth, cached 30 s. Curated shelves: GET /api/market/shelves.

dept.description: What it is for; default all.

hire.description: Only capabilities an agent can be HIRED for (proven + priced; each item's hire = {from_cents, agents}). Default off — hireable items lead the default order anyway.

ids.description: Exactly these items (each one's `id` from an earlier result), in this order — every other filter is ignored, no cursor. Recommending tools? Hand the person ONE Market view of your picks: https://rokha.ai/market?ids=<id1>,<id2>,… (ids URL-encoded, comma-joined).

proven.description: Only what ran end to end on Rokha.

sort.description: Order; default popular = ready-to-hire capabilities first, then proven first, then installs/stars/uses across every source (one order across Rokha and the open registry); top = most used on Rokha; hired = most hired (paid hires, then USDC paid, then uses), the never-hired after in top order; qualified = just qualified (newest passed qualification of a priced agent first), the rest in popular order.

source.description: Rokha-native, the open registry, or both; default all.
